tasks.title: Scaffold frontend app and tooling (TypeScript, bundler, linting)
tasks.details: Scaffolded Vite + TypeScript app with ESLint tooling.

tasks.title: Build PDF upload flow and render Page 1 with PDF.js viewer
tasks.details: Added PDF upload dropzone and rendered page 1 with PDF.js canvas preview.

tasks.title: Extract PDF page text with offsets and map to PDF.js text items
tasks.details: Extracted PDF page text into a full string with per-item character ranges for mapping back to PDF.js text items.

tasks.title: Implement sentence segmentation utility with page/position metadata
tasks.details: Added sentence segmentation utility with paragraph/sentence indices and offsets for PDF page text.

tasks.title: Render highlight overlay rectangles on PDF pages from sentence ranges
tasks.details: Added PDF highlight overlay layer and rectangle mapping from sentence ranges to text items.

tasks.title: Integrate Transformers.js embeddings pipeline with WebGPU/WASM fallback
tasks.details: Added Transformers.js feature-extraction pipeline with WebGPU/WASM fallback and page 1 embedding prep.

tasks.title: Implement embedding pooling, normalization, and cosine similarity helpers
tasks.details: Added mean pooling, attention-mask handling, L2 normalization, and cosine similarity helpers; embeddings now pool per sentence.

tasks.title: Implement auto-highlight scoring (centrality/globality/priors) and MMR selection
tasks.details: Implemented auto-highlight scoring with centrality/globality priors, length/position boosts, and MMR-based selection.

tasks.title: Add progressive processing: Page 1 fast path, background page indexing, progress UI
tasks.details: Added background page indexing after page 1 with a progress panel and status updates.

tasks.title: Export highlighted PDF for PDF inputs using pdf-lib rectangles with correct coordinates
tasks.details: Added highlighted PDF export using pdf-lib rectangles and a download action.

tasks.title: Implement Study Strip UI grouped by page with pin/unpin highlights
tasks.details: Added Study Strip panel grouped by page with pin and unpin toggles.

tasks.title: Add Study Strip export: copy to clipboard and download highlights.md
tasks.details: Added Study Strip export buttons for copy/download with markdown formatting and clipboard support.

tasks.title: Implement DOCX import via mammoth and sanitized reading view rendering
tasks.details: Added DOCX upload flow using mammoth conversion with a sanitized reading view.

tasks.title: Paginate Word/URL/Text into virtual pages and highlight inline spans
tasks.details: Paginated DOCX content into virtual pages and rendered inline highlights with docx page indexing.

tasks.title: Implement URL fetch via r.jina.ai with markdown/text rendering
tasks.details: Added URL fetch via r.jina.ai with markdown rendering into the reading view.

tasks.title: Implement paste-text input flow with virtual page rendering
tasks.details: Added paste-text input flow with virtual page rendering and study strip support.

tasks.title: Export highlighted PDF for Word/URL/Text sources (generated PDF with highlights)
tasks.details: Added highlighted PDF export for reading view sources using html2canvas snapshots.

tasks.title: Add question highlight mode with query embedding and top-K selection
tasks.details: Added question highlight mode with query embedding and top-K selection.

tasks.title: Implement highlight intensity control and mode toggles in UI
tasks.details: Added highlight intensity controls that adjust highlight counts and added auto/question mode toggle UI.

tasks.title: Add accessibility features: keyboard nav, contrast checks, alternate list view
tasks.details: Added keyboard page navigation, contrast-aware highlight styling with list view toggle, and an accessible highlights list view.

tasks.title: Add performance guardrails: caps, batching, yield to UI, optional Web Worker
tasks.details: Added caps for auto-indexed pages/sentences, batched embeddings with UI yields, and a worker-backed embedding option.

tasks.title: Add privacy/security disclosures and HTML sanitization for rendered content
tasks.details: Added privacy/security disclosure panel and documented sanitization for reading view content.

tasks.title: Handle scanned PDFs with empty text extraction and user-facing warning
tasks.details: Added a scanned PDF warning when text extraction is empty.

tasks.title: Create multilingual smoke-test plan and sample docs for manual QA
tasks.details: Created multilingual smoke test plan and sample text fixtures for English, Spanish, French, Chinese, and Arabic.

tasks.title: Fix PDF embedding race when navigating pages
tasks.details: Scoped PDF embedding updates to target pages to avoid cross-page highlight corruption during navigation.

tasks.title: Reset sentence cap on reading-view re-pagination
tasks.details: Reset auto sentence caps when re-paginating reading views so highlights re-index after resize.

tasks.title: Sanitize download filenames for URL/text sources
tasks.details: Sanitized URL/text export filenames by stripping path separators and unsafe characters before download.

tasks.title: Implement document-level centroid sampling for auto highlights
tasks.details: Computed document centroid from sampled sentence embeddings and used it for globality scoring.

tasks.title: Add MMR selection for question highlights
tasks.details: Applied MMR selection to question highlights to reduce redundancy.

tasks.title: Layer question highlights on top of auto highlights
tasks.details: Question mode now layers answer overlays on top of auto highlights across the viewer, list, and study strip.

tasks.title: Add PDF and reading-view navigation controls
tasks.details: Added page navigation controls with prev/next buttons and page jump for PDF and reading views.

tasks.title: Add interactive highlight tooltip with pin/unpin
tasks.details: Added highlight tooltips for PDF and reading-view highlights with pin/unpin toggles.

tasks.title: Add cancel or pause control for background indexing
tasks.details: Added pause/resume control for background indexing with progress panel updates.

tasks.title: Ensure exports cover full document highlights
tasks.details: Require confirmation before exporting partial highlights so exports default to full-document coverage.

tasks.title: Add Study Strip visibility toggle
tasks.details: Added a Study Strip show/hide toggle with a collapsible body and mobile-friendly layout.

tasks.title: Clarify reading-view export limitations
tasks.details: Updated reading-view export note to warn that html2canvas exports are image-based and text may not be selectable.

tasks.title: Encode highlight intensity by score with non-color cues
tasks.details: Mapped highlight scores to intensity tiers with non-color cues across viewer, reading view, and list/strip.

tasks.title: Persist pinned highlights across mode or intensity changes
tasks.details: Pinned highlights now persist across mode/intensity changes by always including pinned sentences in active highlight rendering and exports.

tasks.title: Add question preset chips
tasks.details: Added preset question chips that fill the query and trigger highlighting.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for segmentation, scoring, and sanitization
tasks.details: Added Vitest coverage for segmentation, scoring/MMR, sanitization, and filename handling; extracted shared highlight utilities.

tasks.title: Expand QA coverage and run smoke checks
tasks.details: Added Playwright smoke tests for text/URL/PDF flows using QA-mode deterministic embeddings; ran npm run test:smoke.

tasks.title: Accept PDFs with missing MIME types in upload validation
tasks.details: Accepted PDFs with empty MIME types by falling back to the .pdf extension check.

tasks.title: Destroy previous PDF.js documents on reset
tasks.details: Call pdfDoc.destroy() before clearing state so repeated uploads do not leak PDF.js resources.

tasks.title: Skip synthetic spaces between CJK characters during PDF text extraction
tasks.details: Refine needsSyntheticSpace to avoid inserting spaces between Han/Kana/Hangul runs so extracted text and Study Strip remain verbatim for CJK PDFs.

tasks.title: Fix reading-view export when List view is active
tasks.details: html2canvas export uses the reading-view pages; when List view hides the viewer (display: none), captures can be blank. Ensure export temporarily renders the reading view offscreen or switches to preview during capture, then restores the prior view.

tasks.title: Fix reading-view pagination when List view hides the viewer
tasks.details: When List view is active, docxViewer is display:none so pagination uses zero scrollHeight and collapses content onto page 1 (including on resize). Ensure pagination runs with a measurable layout (temporarily switch to preview or use an offscreen container), then restore view mode.

tasks.title: Preserve pinned highlights across reading-view repagination
tasks.details: Pinned highlight IDs stay stable across reading-view repagination and persist during reindexing.

tasks.title: Preserve target/rel on sanitized URL links
tasks.details: Preserved target/rel on sanitized URL links and added regression coverage.

tasks.title: Guard PDF page-1 embedding updates after navigation
tasks.details: Re-checked current page before applying page-1 embedding updates to avoid cross-page highlight updates; added a QA step for navigation during embeddings.
